\*\* Ironbridge National Bank, N.A. --- First Markup (Bank Turn 1)*\** ( Redline against Pinnacle Capital Partners Standard Form ACA)\* Blackmere Fox LLP Reference: BF-IRB-25-00893 Returned: May 5, 2025
**[DEPOSIT ACCOUNT CONTROL AGREEMENT]{.underline}**
This DEPOSIT ACCOUNT CONTROL AGREEMENT (this \"Agreement\") is entered into as of \[DATE\], 20\_\_ (the \"Effective Date\"), by and among the following parties:
**SECURED PARTY:**
> Pinnacle Capital Partners, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, and its successors and assigns (the \"Secured Party\");
**DEPOSITOR / DEBTOR:**
> Graycliff Industries, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the \"Depositor\" or \"Debtor\"); and
**DEPOSITORY BANK:**
> Ironbridge National Bank, N.A., a national banking association chartered under the laws of the OCC Charter No. 18742 (the \"Bank\").
Each of the Secured Party, the Depositor, and the Bank is sometimes referred to herein individually as a \"Party\" and collectively as the \"Parties.\"
**[RECITALS]{.underline}**

**WHEREAS**, Depositor maintains one or more deposit accounts at Bank, each as more particularly identified and described on Schedule A attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference (collectively, the \"Accounts\" and each individually, an \"Account\");

**WHEREAS**, Secured Party has been granted a security interest in, and lien upon, such Accounts and all funds, cash, instruments, investment property, and other property at any time credited thereto, pursuant to that certain Credit Agreement dated as of April 14, 2025, by and between Depositor and Secured Party, with a maturity date of April 14, 2030, as the same may be amended, restated, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time, together with all related security agreements, pledge agreements, guaranties, and ancillary documents executed in connection therewith (collectively, the \"Loan Documents\");

**WHEREAS**, the Parties desire to enter into this Agreement to establish \"control\" (as such term is defined and used in Article 9 of the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in the State of North Carolina) by the Secured Party over the Accounts in order to perfect the security interest of the Secured Party therein; and
**WHEREAS**, Bank is willing to enter into this Agreement on the terms and conditions set forth herein.

**NOW, THEREFORE**, in consideration of the mutual covenants, representations, and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereby agree as follows:
**[Section 1 --- Definitions]{.underline}**

As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below. Capitalized terms used but not otherwise defined in this Agreement shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Loan Documents or, if not defined therein, in the UCC.

**\"Account\"** or **\"Deposit Account\"** means each deposit account identified on Schedule A hereto, including any and all renewals, replacements, or successor accounts thereof, and all funds, cash, instruments, and other property at any time credited to, deposited in, or otherwise attributable to any such account, together with all interest, income, and other earnings thereon and all proceeds (as defined in the UCC) thereof.
**\"Bank Obligations\"** means any and all obligations owed to Bank by Depositor, whether direct or contingent, now existing or hereafter arising, whether or not related to the Accounts.

**\"Business Day\"** means any day on which Bank is open for the conduct of substantially all of its commercial banking business at its offices in Charlotte, North Carolina, excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and any day on which banking institutions in the State of North Carolina are authorized or required by law or executive order to close.

**\"Event of Default\"** means an \"Event of Default\" as defined in, and determined in accordance with, the Loan Documents, or as otherwise notified by Secured Party to Bank pursuant to a Notice of Exclusive Control delivered in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, Bank shall have no obligation or duty to independently determine whether an Event of Default has occurred or is continuing under the Loan Documents.

**\"Exclusive Control Notice\"** or **\"Notice of Exclusive Control\"** (each, an **\"NOEC\"**) means a written notice delivered by Secured Party to Bank in accordance with Section 5 hereof, substantially in the form attached hereto as Exhibit A (if any), asserting that an Event of Default has occurred under the Loan Documents and directing Bank to comply exclusively with Instructions originated by or on behalf of Secured Party with respect to the Accounts, and to cease complying with any and all Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor.

**\"Instructions\"** means any order, direction, instruction, request, or authorization regarding the disposition of funds in, or any other action to be taken or omitted with respect to, any Account, including without limitation directions to initiate or execute wire transfers, ACH transactions, checks, withdrawals, transfers between accounts, account closings, and the provision of account statements, balance information, and other account-related information.
**\"Lien\"** means any security interest, lien, charge, encumbrance, claim, right of set-off, or other interest or right of any kind, whether arising by contract, operation of law, or otherwise.

**\"Loan Documents\"** means, collectively, the credit agreement, loan agreement, security agreement, and all related agreements, instruments, certificates, and documents between or among Depositor and Secured Party (and any guarantors or other obligors party thereto), as the same may be amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented, replaced, or otherwise modified from time to time.

**\"UCC\"** means the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect from time to time in the State of North Carolina; provided that, to the extent that the UCC is used to define any term herein and such term is defined differently in different Articles or Divisions of the UCC, the definition of such term contained in Article 9 shall govern. In the event that, by reason of mandatory provisions of law, any of the attachment, perfection, or priority of the Secured Party\'s security interest in any Account is governed by the Uniform Commercial Code as enacted and in effect in a jurisdiction other than the State of North Carolina, the term \"UCC\" shall mean the Uniform Commercial Code as enacted and in effect in such other jurisdiction solely for purposes of the provisions hereof relating to such attachment, perfection, or priority and for purposes of definitions relating to such provisions.

All other capitalized terms used in this Agreement and not specifically defined herein shall have the meanings assigned to such terms in the Loan Documents. To the extent a term is defined both in this Agreement and in the Loan Documents, the definition set forth in this Agreement shall control for purposes of this Agreement.
**[Section 2 --- The Accounts; Establishment of Control]{.underline}**

**2.1 Confirmation of Accounts.** Bank hereby confirms and acknowledges that (a) each Account listed on Schedule A hereto is maintained at Bank, (b) each such Account is held in the name of Depositor as the account holder of record, (c) each such Account constitutes a \"deposit account\" within the meaning of the UCC, and (d) Bank is the \"bank\" (as defined in UCC Section 9-102(a)(8)) with respect to each such Account.

**2.2 Establishment of Control.** Bank hereby agrees that, from and after the Effective Date, it will comply with Instructions originated by Secured Party directing the disposition of funds in the Accounts without further consent of Depositor, thereby establishing \"control\" by Secured Party over the Accounts within the meaning of UCC Section 9-104(a)(2) . Bank acknowledges and agrees that such compliance obligation is unconditional and shall not be subject to any conditions precedent other than the delivery of such Instructions in a manner consistent with Section 10 of this Agreement. The Parties intend that this Agreement shall satisfy all requirements for the establishment and perfection of control by Secured Party over the Accounts under the UCC, and each Party agrees to take such further actions and execute such additional documents as may be reasonably necessary to effectuate such intent.

**2.3 No Changes to Accounts Without Consent.** Bank shall not, without the prior written consent of Secured Party, (a) change the name, account number, title, designation, or ownership of any Account, (b) close, terminate, or redesignate any Account, (c) open any new account for Depositor that is intended to be subject to this Agreement, (d) merge, combine, or consolidate any Account with any other account or obligation of Depositor at Bank, or (e) permit any change to the authorized signatories on any Account if such change has been objected to in writing by Secured Party.

**2.4 Depositor\'s Consent.** Depositor hereby irrevocably authorizes and consents to Bank\'s compliance with all Instructions originated by Secured Party, without any obligation of Bank to inquire into the right, authority, or entitlement of Secured Party to issue such Instructions, and without any obligation of Bank to provide notice to Depositor of its receipt or execution of any such Instructions. Depositor acknowledges that Bank shall have no liability to Depositor for complying with any Instruction originated by Secured Party in accordance with the terms of this Agreement.

**2.5 Depositor\'s Operating Rights Prior to Notice of Exclusive Control.** Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, unless and until Bank has received a Notice of Exclusive Control in accordance with Section 5, Depositor shall have the full and unrestricted right to issue Instructions to Bank with respect to the Accounts, including but not limited to directing the withdrawal, transfer, payment, and disposition of funds in the Accounts in the ordinary course of Depositor\'s business, without any requirement of consent or notification to Secured Party. Bank shall have no obligation to inquire whether any Instruction originated by Depositor prior to receipt of a NOEC is consistent with the Loan Documents, any standing instructions from Secured Party, or any other agreement between Depositor and Secured Party.
**[\[DELETED: Section 3 --- Exclusive Control Upon Event of Default\] \[ADDED: Section 3 --- Priority of Bank Set-Off Rights\]]{.underline}**

**3.1 Bank Priority.** Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement, Bank\'s rights of set-off, recoupment, banker\'s lien, and security interest (whether arising by contract, law, or equity) in and against the Accounts and all funds therein shall at all times be prior and superior to any Instructions received from Secured Party and to any Lien or claim of Secured Party in the Accounts.

**3.2 Conflict Resolution.** In the event of any conflict between (i) Bank\'s exercise of its set-off, recoupment, or lien rights with respect to Bank Obligations and (ii) Instructions received from Secured Party, Bank\'s exercise of such rights shall prevail and Bank shall have no liability to Secured Party for complying with Bank\'s own rights in priority to Secured Party\'s Instructions.

**3.3 Notice of Exercise.** Bank shall use commercially reasonable efforts to notify Secured Party promptly following any exercise of set-off against the Accounts, but failure to provide such notice shall not affect the validity or priority of any such exercise.

\[DELETED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) Bank shall immediately cease complying with any and all Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor with respect to the Accounts, and shall reject, refuse to honor, and return unpaid any checks, drafts, ACH debits, wire transfer requests, withdrawal requests, or other payment orders or instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor that are presented to or received by Bank on or after the date of Bank\'s compliance with the Notice of Exclusive Control;

\(b\) Bank shall comply solely and exclusively with Instructions and Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Secured Party with respect to the Accounts, including without limitation Instructions directing:
> \(i\) wire transfers of funds from any Account to any account designated by Secured Party;
> \(ii\) ACH debits and credits with respect to any Account;
> \(iii\) withdrawals of funds from any Account by any means;
> \(iv\) the closing of any or all Accounts and the remittance of all remaining balances to Secured Party or as Secured Party may direct;

> \(v\) the redirection of all account statements, balance information, transaction reports, and other correspondence and information relating to the Accounts exclusively to Secured Party at the address specified by Secured Party; and
> \(vi\) any other action with respect to the Accounts as Secured Party may direct from time to time;

\(c\) Bank shall freeze and block all automated or preauthorized debits, standing payment orders, and recurring transactions originated by or on behalf of Depositor with respect to the Accounts, unless and until Secured Party provides written Instructions to the contrary; and
\(d\) Bank shall provide Secured Party with a complete and current statement of the balance and recent transaction history for each Account promptly upon request. \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]
**[\[DELETED: Section 4 --- Conflicting Instructions; Waterfall\] \[ADDED: Section 4 --- Self-Help Set-Off\]]{.underline}**

\[DELETED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) **First:** Instructions of Secured Party shall be given first priority and shall be complied with immediately, without regard to any conflicting Instructions from Depositor;

\(b\) **Second:** Instructions of Depositor shall be given second priority and shall be complied with only to the extent (i) such Instructions are not inconsistent with, and do not conflict with, any Instructions previously or concurrently received from Secured Party, and (ii) no Notice of Exclusive Control is then in effect. \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]

**4.1 Reservation of Set-Off Rights.** Bank reserves and retains the unrestricted right to set off, charge, debit, or apply funds in any Account against any obligation owed to Bank by Depositor, whether direct or contingent, now existing or hereafter arising, whether or not related to the Accounts, and whether matured or unmatured, liquidated or unliquidated, including without limitation obligations arising under any loan, credit facility, treasury management service, letter of credit, foreign exchange transaction, interest rate swap, or other agreement between Bank and Depositor (collectively, \"Bank Obligations\").
**4.2 No Prior Notice or Consent Required.** Bank may exercise such set-off right without prior notice to, or consent of, Secured Party or Depositor.
**[\[DELETED: Section 5 --- Subordination of Bank Liens; Waiver of Set-Off\] \[ADDED: Section 5 --- Notice of Exclusive Control; Compliance Period\]]{.underline}**

\[DELETED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) Bank\'s standard published account maintenance fees, service charges, and transaction fees applicable to the Accounts in accordance with Bank\'s standard fee schedule as provided to Depositor from time to time in the ordinary course; and

\(b\) the right to charge back to the Accounts any returned, reversed, dishonored, or charged-back items (including returned deposited checks, reversed ACH entries, and recalled wire transfers) credited to the Accounts in error or subject to return under applicable law or clearing house rules;

*provided*, however, that in no event shall the aggregate amount of fees deducted or items charged back by Bank pursuant to clauses (a) and (b) above exceed \$**\_\_** in the aggregate during any calendar month without the prior written consent of Secured Party. Bank shall provide Secured Party with a monthly summary of all fees deducted and items charged back pursuant to this Section 5.3 promptly upon request. \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]
**5.1 Effect of Notice of Exclusive Control.** Upon receipt by Bank of a Notice of Exclusive Control from Secured Party delivered in accordance with Section 10 of this Agreement:

\[ADDED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) Bank shall cease complying with any and all Instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor with respect to the Accounts, and shall reject, refuse to honor, and return unpaid any checks, drafts, ACH debits, wire transfer requests, withdrawal requests, or other payment orders or instructions originated by or on behalf of Depositor that are presented to or received by Bank on or after the date of Bank\'s compliance with the Notice of Exclusive Control;
\(b\) Bank shall comply solely and exclusively with Instructions originated by or on behalf of Secured Party with respect to the Accounts, including without limitation Instructions directing:
> \(i\) wire transfers of funds from any Account to any account designated by Secured Party;
> \(ii\) ACH debits and credits with respect to any Account;
> \(iii\) withdrawals of funds from any Account by any means;
> \(iv\) the closing of any or all Accounts and the remittance of all remaining balances to Secured Party or as Secured Party may direct;

> \(v\) the redirection of all account statements, balance information, transaction reports, and other correspondence and information relating to the Accounts exclusively to Secured Party at the address specified by Secured Party; and
> \(vi\) any other action with respect to the Accounts as Secured Party may direct from time to time;

\(c\) Bank shall freeze and block all automated or preauthorized debits, standing payment orders, and recurring transactions originated by or on behalf of Depositor with respect to the Accounts, unless and until Secured Party provides written Instructions to the contrary; and
\(d\) Bank shall provide Secured Party with a complete and current statement of the balance and recent transaction history for each Account promptly upon request. \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]

**5.2 NOEC Compliance Period.** Bank shall comply with a Notice of Exclusive Control within five (5) Business Days of receipt thereof (the \"NOEC Compliance Period\"). During the NOEC Compliance Period, Bank shall use commercially reasonable efforts to implement the notice as promptly as practicable; *provided*, however, that Bank shall not be liable for checks, ACH entries, or wire transfers that were irrevocably initiated or submitted into a payment system prior to the expiration of the NOEC Compliance Period and that settle or clear after such period, so long as Bank acted in good faith and used commercially reasonable efforts to prevent such transactions from clearing.

**5.3 No Requirement of Proof.** Bank shall not require Secured Party to present evidence of the occurrence or continuance of an Event of Default, a court order, a judgment, a certificate from Depositor, or any other documentation whatsoever as a condition to Bank\'s compliance with a Notice of Exclusive Control. Bank\'s sole obligation upon receipt of a Notice of Exclusive Control shall be to verify that such notice is in writing, purports to come from Secured Party (or an authorized representative thereof), is directed to Bank in accordance with Section 10, and requests Bank to comply exclusively with Instructions of Secured Party. Upon such verification, Bank shall be fully authorized and directed to comply with the Notice of Exclusive Control, and Bank shall have no duty to make any further inquiry or investigation.

**5.4 Depositor\'s Waiver.** Depositor hereby irrevocably and unconditionally waives any right to challenge, contest, object to, or otherwise dispute Bank\'s compliance with any Notice of Exclusive Control or any Instruction originated by Secured Party in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. Depositor acknowledges that any remedy or recourse Depositor may have in connection with the issuance of a Notice of Exclusive Control or the exercise by Secured Party of its rights hereunder shall be solely against Secured Party and not against Bank, and Depositor shall not assert any claim against Bank arising out of or related to Bank\'s compliance with any Instruction originated by Secured Party.

**5.5 Rescission of Notice of Exclusive Control.** A Notice of Exclusive Control shall remain in effect until Secured Party delivers a written notice to Bank rescinding or withdrawing the Notice of Exclusive Control (a \"Rescission Notice\"). Upon receipt by Bank of a Rescission Notice, the provisions of Section 2.5 shall again apply, and Bank shall resume complying with Instructions of Depositor in the ordinary course of business, subject to the continuing obligations of Bank under Section 2.2 hereof. Bank shall comply with a Rescission Notice within two (2) Business Days of receipt thereof.
**[Section 6 --- \[DELETED: Representations and Warranties\] \[ADDED: Indemnification\]]{.underline}**

\[DELETED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) **Organization and Authority.** Bank is a national banking association duly organized, validly existing, and in good standing under the laws of the United States. Bank has full power, authority, and legal right to enter into this Agreement, to perform its obligations hereunder, and to carry out the transactions contemplated hereby. The execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement by Bank have been duly authorized by all necessary corporate or organizational action on the part of Bank.

\(b\) **Exclusive Control; No Other Agreements.** The Accounts are solely in the name of Depositor, and no other person or entity (other than Secured Party pursuant to this Agreement) has been granted control (within the meaning of the UCC) over the Accounts. Bank has not entered into, and covenants that it will not enter into, any other control agreement, blocked account agreement, escrow agreement, or similar agreement or arrangement with respect to the Accounts without the prior written consent of Secured Party.

\(c\) **No Other Liens or Claims.** Bank has received no notice of any Lien, claim, interest, or adverse claim in, to, or with respect to the Accounts other than the security interest and Lien of Secured Party as contemplated hereby. Bank is not aware of any pending or threatened claim, demand, action, or proceeding against or affecting the Accounts.

\(d\) **Bank\'s Jurisdiction.** Bank\'s jurisdiction for purposes of UCC Section 9-304 is the State of New York. Bank agrees that it will not change its jurisdiction (as determined under UCC Section 9-304) without providing Secured Party at least thirty (30) days\' prior written notice thereof.

\(e\) **No Existing Defaults or Claims.** As of the Effective Date, there are no existing conditions of default, events of default, or outstanding set-off claims or counterclaims by Bank with respect to the Accounts or any funds therein. Bank has no present intention to exercise any right of set-off, combination, or counterclaim with respect to the Accounts.

\(f\) **Enforceability.** This Agreement constitutes a legal, valid, and binding obligation of Bank, enforceable against Bank in accordance with its terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium, and similar laws affecting creditors\' rights generally and to general principles of equity (whether considered in a proceeding in equity or at law). \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]

\[DELETED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) **Ownership.** Depositor is the sole and exclusive legal and beneficial owner of the Accounts and all funds, property, and proceeds therein, free and clear of all Liens other than the security interest and Lien of Secured Party as contemplated by the Loan Documents and this Agreement.

\(b\) **No Prior Control Agreements.** Depositor has not granted control of, or any Lien on, the Accounts (or any funds therein) to any person or entity other than Secured Party. There are no prior or existing control agreements, blocked account agreements, notices of lien, tax levies, garnishments, or adverse claims affecting the Accounts, other than this Agreement.

\(c\) **Organization and Authority.** Depositor is a **\_\_\_\_\_** *duly organized, validly existing, and in good standing under the laws of* **\_\_\_\_\_**. Depositor has full power, authority, and legal right to enter into this Agreement, to grant Secured Party control over the Accounts as contemplated hereby, and to perform its obligations hereunder. The execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement by Depositor have been duly authorized by all necessary corporate, limited liability company, partnership, or other organizational action on the part of Depositor.

\(d\) **No Conflicts.** The execution, delivery, and performance by Depositor of this Agreement do not and will not (i) violate, conflict with, or result in a breach of any provision of Depositor\'s organizational documents, (ii) violate, conflict with, or result in a breach or default under any agreement, contract, instrument, or obligation to which Depositor is a party or by which Depositor or its property is bound, or (iii) violate any applicable law, rule, regulation, order, judgment, or decree.

\(e\) **Enforceability.** This Agreement constitutes a legal, valid, and binding obligation of Depositor, enforceable against Depositor in accordance with its terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium, and similar laws affecting creditors\' rights generally and to general principles of equity (whether considered in a proceeding in equity or at law). \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]

**6.1 Secured Party Indemnification.** Secured Party agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Bank and its officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives (each, a \"Bank Indemnitee\") from and against any and all losses, claims, damages, liabilities, deficiencies, judgments, settlements, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys\' fees and disbursements, court costs, and expenses of investigation) (collectively, \"Losses\") incurred by, imposed upon, or asserted against any Bank Indemnitee arising out of, resulting from, or related to:
\[ADDED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) Bank\'s compliance with any Instructions originated by or on behalf of Secured Party pursuant to this Agreement;
\(b\) Bank\'s compliance with any Notice of Exclusive Control delivered by Secured Party pursuant to Section 5 of this Agreement;

\(c\) any action taken or omitted by Bank in reliance upon this Agreement or upon any notice, instruction, direction, certificate, or other document furnished by or on behalf of Secured Party hereunder; and

\(d\) any claim by Depositor or any third party arising out of or relating to Bank\'s compliance with Instructions or directions of Secured Party or Bank\'s refusal to comply with Instructions of Depositor following delivery of a Notice of Exclusive Control. \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]

**6.2 Scope of Indemnification.** The indemnification obligations of Secured Party under Section 6.1 shall apply regardless of whether such Losses arise in whole or in part from the negligence (including gross negligence) of Bank, and shall be limited only where such Losses are determined by a court of competent jurisdiction in a final, non-appealable judgment to have resulted solely and directly from the willful misconduct of Bank.

**6.3 Depositor Indemnification.** Depositor also agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless each Bank Indemnitee from and against any and all Losses incurred by, imposed upon, or asserted against any Bank Indemnitee arising out of or related to (a) any breach by Depositor of any representation, warranty, covenant, or obligation of Depositor contained in this Agreement, (b) any inaccuracy in any representation or warranty made by Depositor herein, or (c) any claim by a third party arising out of or relating to the Accounts or the funds therein, to the extent such claim does not arise from the acts or omissions of Bank or Secured Party. The indemnification obligations of Depositor under this Section 6.3 shall be independent of, and in addition to, the indemnification obligations of Secured Party under Section 6.1, and Bank may seek indemnification from either or both of Secured Party and Depositor, as applicable, without regard to the order of priority or any requirement of exhaustion.

**6.4 Indemnification Procedure.** Any Bank Indemnitee seeking indemnification under this Section 6 shall promptly notify the indemnifying party in writing of the claim, demand, action, or proceeding giving rise to such indemnification obligation; *provided*, however, that the failure to provide such notice shall not relieve the indemnifying party of its indemnification obligations except to the extent the indemnifying party is materially prejudiced by such failure. The indemnifying party shall have the right, at its sole cost and expense, to assume the defense of any such claim, demand, action, or proceeding, subject to the right of the Bank Indemnitee to retain separate counsel at the indemnifying party\'s expense if the Bank Indemnitee reasonably determines that a conflict of interest exists.
**[Section 7 --- \[DELETED: Secured Party Indemnification of Bank\] \[ADDED: Limitation of Liability\]]{.underline}**
\[DELETED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) Bank\'s compliance with any Instructions or Entitlement Orders originated by or on behalf of Secured Party pursuant to this Agreement;
\(b\) Bank\'s compliance with any Notice of Exclusive Control delivered by Secured Party pursuant to Section 3 of this Agreement;

\(c\) any action taken or omitted by Bank in good faith reliance upon this Agreement or upon any notice, instruction, direction, certificate, or other document furnished by or on behalf of Secured Party hereunder; and

\(d\) any claim by Depositor or any third party arising out of or relating to Bank\'s compliance with Instructions or directions of Secured Party or Bank\'s refusal to comply with Instructions of Depositor following delivery of a Notice of Exclusive Control. \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]

**7.1 Aggregate Liability Cap.** Bank\'s aggregate liability under or in connection with this Agreement, whether arising in contract, tort, strict liability, or otherwise, shall not exceed Fifty Thousand Dollars (\$50,000). The foregoing limitation shall not apply to Losses resulting from Bank\'s willful misconduct.

**7.2 Mutual Waiver of Consequential, Punitive, and Indirect Damages.** NO PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO ANY OTHER PARTY FOR ANY INDIRECT, CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, PUNITIVE, OR EXEMPLARY DAMAGES OF ANY KIND WHATSOEVER, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION LOST PROFITS, LOSS OF BUSINESS OPPORTUNITY, OR LOSS OF GOODWILL, ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THIS AGREEMENT, WHETHER BASED ON CONTRACT, TORT (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE), STRICT LIABILITY, OR ANY OTHER THEORY, EVEN IF SUCH PARTY HAS BEEN ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.

**7.3 No Duty to Monitor.** Bank shall have no duty or obligation to (a) monitor or audit the Accounts, the transactions therein, or the use of funds in the Accounts, (b) verify the identity or authority of any person or entity issuing Instructions on behalf of Secured Party or Depositor, beyond Bank\'s standard authentication procedures, (c) determine whether an Event of Default has occurred or is continuing under the Loan Documents, (d) inquire into the purpose, propriety, or legality of any Instruction, or (e) monitor or enforce compliance by Depositor or Secured Party with any of the terms of the Loan Documents or any other agreement between or among Depositor and Secured Party.

**7.4 Good Faith Reliance.** Bank may rely on the genuineness and authority of any notice, instruction, certificate, statement, direction, or other document or communication reasonably believed by it in good faith to be genuine and to have been signed, sent, or transmitted by an authorized person of the party purporting to have originated such document or communication. Bank shall not be liable for any action taken or omitted in good faith in reliance upon any such document or communication.

**7.5 No Fiduciary Duty.** Secured Party acknowledges and agrees that Bank is acting solely in its capacity as a depository bank and custodian of the Accounts, and that Bank does not owe, and shall not be deemed to owe, any fiduciary duty, duty of loyalty, duty of care, or other duty of any kind to Secured Party, whether arising under this Agreement, the UCC, common law, equity, or otherwise, except as expressly set forth in this Agreement.
**[Section 8 --- \[DELETED: Limitation of Liability\] \[ADDED: Subordination of Bank Liens (Limited)\]]{.underline}**

**8.1 Limited Subordination.** Bank agrees to subordinate its Liens in the Accounts solely to the extent of fees, charges, and returned items that have accrued or been incurred during the ninety (90) day period immediately preceding the date of delivery of a Notice of Exclusive Control (the \"Lookback Period\"); provided that Bank\'s Liens with respect to Bank Obligations accrued or arising prior to such 90-day Lookback Period, or accruing after the date of delivery of such NOEC, shall not be subordinated and shall remain prior and superior to the Lien of Secured Party.

**8.2 Fees Not Subject to Subordination.** Bank\'s standard published account maintenance and service fees and the fees set forth in Section 11 shall not be subject to subordination under this Section 8.
**[Section 9 --- \[DELETED: Successor Bank; Notification Obligations\] \[ADDED: Termination\]]{.underline}**
\[DELETED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) any attachment, levy, garnishment, tax lien, or other legal process served on Bank with respect to any Account or any funds therein;

\(b\) any adverse claim, notice of lien, stop payment order, or other claim or demand received by Bank from any third party with respect to any Account or any funds therein (other than routine garnishments or levies arising in the ordinary course, which shall nonetheless be reported);
\(c\) any change in the account numbers assigned to any Account, whether resulting from a system migration, regulatory requirement, or otherwise;
\(d\) any dishonored, returned, reversed, or charged-back item charged to any Account in an amount in excess of \$**\_\_** individually or \$**\_\_** in the aggregate during any calendar month;

\(e\) any material change in Bank\'s standard terms and conditions, fee schedule, or account agreements applicable to the Accounts that could reasonably be expected to affect Secured Party\'s rights or interests hereunder; and

\(f\) any regulatory action, cease and desist order, consent order, or similar enforcement action directed at Bank that could reasonably be expected to materially impair Bank\'s ability to perform its obligations under this Agreement. \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]

**9.1 Termination by Secured Party.** This Agreement may be terminated upon the prior written consent of Secured Party, delivered to Bank and Depositor in accordance with Section 10 hereof. Any purported termination of this Agreement without the prior written consent of Secured Party shall be void and of no force or effect.

**9.2 Secured Party\'s Obligation to Consent to Termination.** Secured Party shall deliver its written consent to the termination of this Agreement promptly (and in any event within ten (10) Business Days) following the satisfaction of each of the following conditions: (a) the indefeasible payment in full, in cash, of all obligations, indebtedness, and liabilities of Depositor to Secured Party under or in connection with the Loan Documents (including all principal, interest, fees, costs, expenses, and other amounts), (b) the termination, cancellation, or expiration of all commitments of Secured Party to extend credit to Depositor under the Loan Documents, and (c) the release or termination of all security interests, liens, and pledges granted by Depositor to Secured Party under or in connection with the Loan Documents. Upon delivery of such written consent, this Agreement shall terminate and be of no further force or effect, except as expressly provided in Section 9.5.

**9.3 No Unilateral Termination by Depositor.** Depositor may not unilaterally terminate this Agreement. Any attempt by Depositor to terminate this Agreement without the prior written consent of Secured Party shall be void and of no force or effect, and Bank shall not give effect to any request or direction from Depositor to terminate this Agreement unless accompanied by the written consent of Secured Party.

**9.4 Bank Termination.** Bank may terminate this Agreement, in its sole discretion, upon thirty (30) days\' prior written notice to Secured Party and Depositor, delivered in accordance with Section 10 hereof, without cause and without any requirement that a successor depository bank be appointed or a replacement deposit account control agreement be executed.

**9.5 Survival.** The provisions of Section 6 (Indemnification), Section 7 (Limitation of Liability), Section 8 (Subordination of Bank Liens (Limited)), and Section 10 (Governing Law; Jurisdiction; Miscellaneous) shall survive the termination of this Agreement for any reason, to the extent applicable.
**[Section 10 --- \[DELETED: Notices\] \[ADDED: Governing Law; Jurisdiction; Miscellaneous\]]{.underline}**
\[DELETED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) by hand delivery, in which case such notice shall be deemed effective upon receipt by an authorized representative of the receiving party;

\(b\) by a nationally recognized overnight courier service (such as Federal Express, UPS, or DHL), with all charges prepaid, in which case such notice shall be deemed effective on the next Business Day following deposit with such courier;

\(c\) by registered or certified United States mail, postage prepaid, return receipt requested, in which case such notice shall be deemed effective on the third (3rd) Business Day following deposit in the United States mail; or

\(d\) by confirmed facsimile transmission or electronic mail (to the extent such method is authorized for the applicable type of communication as set forth below), in which case such notice shall be deemed effective upon confirmation of successful transmission or delivery, as applicable. \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]

\[DELETED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\>
**Section 10.1 --- Governing Law**

This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed and interpreted in accordance with, the laws of the State of North Carolina, without regard to any conflict-of-laws principles thereof that would require or permit the application of the laws of any other jurisdiction. To the extent not governed by the internal laws of the State of North Carolina, matters relating to the perfection, priority, and enforcement of security interests in the Accounts shall be determined in accordance with the UCC as in effect in the applicable jurisdiction determined pursuant to UCC Section 9-304.
**Section \[DELETED: 12.2\] \[ADDED: 10.2\] --- Jurisdiction; Venue**

Each Party hereto irrevocably and unconditionally submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the federal and state courts located in Mecklenburg County, North Carolina, and any appellate courts thereof, for the purpose of any action, suit, or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement, and each Party hereby irrevocably and unconditionally waives, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, any objection that it may now or hereafter have to the laying of venue of any such action, suit, or proceeding in any such court, and any claim that any such action, suit, or proceeding has been brought in an inconvenient forum. Each Party consents to service of process in any manner permitted by applicable law.
**Section \[DELETED: 12.3\] \[ADDED: 10.3\] --- Waiver of Jury Trial**

**EACH PARTY HERETO HEREBY IRREVOCABLY AND UNCONDITIONALLY WAIVES, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, ANY AND ALL RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION, SUIT, PROCEEDING, CLAIM, OR COUNTERCLAIM ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT OR THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY, WHETHER BASED ON CONTRACT, TORT, OR ANY OTHER THEORY. EACH PARTY ACKNOWLEDGES THAT THIS WAIVER IS A MATERIAL INDUCEMENT TO THE OTHER PARTIES\' ENTERING INTO THIS AGREEMENT, THAT EACH PARTY HAS BEEN AFFORDED THE OPPORTUNITY TO CONSULT WITH LEGAL COUNSEL REGARDING THIS WAIVER, AND THAT THIS WAIVER SHALL BE EFFECTIVE TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW.**
**Section \[DELETED: 12.4\] \[ADDED: 10.4\] --- Amendments**

No amendment, modification, supplement, restatement, or waiver of any provision of this Agreement shall be effective unless set forth in a written instrument duly executed and delivered by each of the three Parties hereto. No waiver of any provision of this Agreement shall constitute a waiver of any other provision (whether or not similar), nor shall any such waiver constitute a continuing waiver unless otherwise expressly provided in writing.
**Section \[DELETED: 12.5\] \[ADDED: 10.5\] --- Entire Agreement**

This Agreement, together with the Schedules attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference, constitutes the entire agreement among the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous agreements, representations, warranties, understandings, negotiations, and discussions, whether written or oral, among the Parties with respect to such subject matter. There are no conditions, warranties, representations, or other agreements among the Parties in connection with the subject matter of this Agreement, whether oral or written, express or implied, except as specifically set forth herein.
**Section \[DELETED: 12.6\] \[ADDED: 10.6\] --- Severability**

If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable in any respect under any applicable law, rule, or regulation in any jurisdiction, such invalidity, illegality, or unenforceability shall not affect the validity, legality, or enforceability of any other provision of this Agreement or the validity, legality, or enforceability of such provision in any other jurisdiction. In the event of any such determination, the Parties shall negotiate in good faith to modify this Agreement so as to effect the original intent of the Parties as closely as possible in an acceptable manner, so that the transactions contemplated hereby are consummated as originally contemplated to the greatest extent possible.
**Section \[DELETED: 12.7\] \[ADDED: 10.7\] --- Counterparts; Electronic Execution**

This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed to be an original, and all of which, when taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart of a signature page to this Agreement by facsimile transmission, by electronic mail in \"portable document format\" (.pdf) form, or by any other electronic means intended to preserve the original graphic and pictorial appearance of a document, shall be effective as delivery of an originally executed counterpart of this Agreement. The words \"execution,\" \"signed,\" \"signature,\" and words of similar import in or relating to this Agreement shall be deemed to include electronic signatures, deliveries, or the keeping of records in electronic form, each of which shall be of the same legal effect, validity, or enforceability as a manually executed signature, physical delivery thereof, or the use of a paper-based recordkeeping system, to the extent and as provided for in any applicable law, including the Federal Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act, the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act as adopted in North Carolina, and any other similar state laws based on the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act.
**Section \[DELETED: 12.8\] \[ADDED: 10.8\] --- Successors and Assigns**

This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of, the Parties hereto and their respective successors, legal representatives, and permitted assigns. Depositor may not assign, delegate, or transfer any of its rights, interests, or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of Secured Party. Secured Party may freely assign, delegate, or transfer any or all of its rights, interests, and obligations under this Agreement, in whole or in part, to any successor, assignee, transferee, or participant under the Loan Documents or otherwise, without the consent of Depositor or Bank, and any such assignee or transferee shall thereupon be vested with all the rights, powers, and remedies of Secured Party hereunder as if originally named as Secured Party herein. Secured Party shall notify Bank in writing of any such assignment or transfer within a commercially reasonable time following the effectiveness thereof.
**Section \[DELETED: 12.9\] \[ADDED: 10.9\] --- No Third-Party Beneficiaries**

This Agreement is for the sole and exclusive benefit of the Parties hereto and their respective successors and permitted assigns, and nothing contained in this Agreement, express or implied, is intended to or shall confer upon any other person or entity any legal or equitable right, benefit, remedy, or claim under or by reason of this Agreement.
**Section \[DELETED: 12.10\] \[ADDED: 10.10\] --- Headings**

The headings, captions, and section titles contained in this Agreement are inserted for convenience of reference only and shall not affect the meaning, interpretation, or construction of any provision of this Agreement.
\## Section 11 --- Fees and Expenses

**11.1 Annual Maintenance Fee.** Depositor shall pay to Bank an annual account control agreement maintenance fee of Three Thousand Five Hundred Dollars (\$3,500) per Account per annum (currently three (3) Accounts, for a total annual fee of Ten Thousand Five Hundred Dollars (\$10,500)), payable in advance on the Effective Date and on each anniversary thereof. Such fee may be debited directly from the Operating Account (Acct ●●●●-4471) without further authorization from Depositor or Secured Party.

**11.2 Legal-Fee Reimbursement.** Depositor shall reimburse Bank for Bank\'s outside legal costs incurred in connection with the review, negotiation, and execution of this Agreement, in an amount equal to Fifteen Thousand Dollars (\$15,000), payable upon execution of this Agreement. Such reimbursement may be debited directly from the Operating Account (Acct ●●●●-4471) upon effectiveness of this Agreement.

**11.3 Priority of Fees.** All fees and reimbursements payable under this Section 11 shall constitute Bank Obligations and shall be entitled to the priority set forth in Section 3 and shall not be subject to subordination under Section 8.
\## Section 12 --- Representations and Warranties
\### Section 12.1 --- Representations and Warranties of Bank
Bank hereby represents and warrants to Secured Party and Depositor, as of the Effective Date and as of each date on which this Agreement remains in effect, as follows:

\[ADDED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) **Organization and Authority.** Bank is a national banking association duly organized, validly existing, and in good standing under the laws of the United States. Bank has full power, authority, and legal right to enter into this Agreement, to perform its obligations hereunder, and to carry out the transactions contemplated hereby. The execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement by Bank have been duly authorized by all necessary corporate or organizational action on the part of Bank.

\(b\) **Exclusive Control.** The Accounts are solely in the name of Depositor, and no other person or entity (other than Secured Party pursuant to this Agreement) has been granted control (within the meaning of the UCC) over the Accounts.

\(c\) **Bank\'s Jurisdiction.** Bank\'s jurisdiction for purposes of UCC Section 9-304 is the State of North Carolina. Bank agrees that it will not change its jurisdiction (as determined under UCC Section 9-304) without providing Secured Party at least thirty (30) days\' prior written notice thereof.

\(d\) **Enforceability.** This Agreement constitutes a legal, valid, and binding obligation of Bank, enforceable against Bank in accordance with its terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium, and similar laws affecting creditors\' rights generally and to general principles of equity (whether considered in a proceeding in equity or at law). \<!\-- /indent \--\>\]
\### Section 12.2 --- Representations and Warranties of Depositor
Depositor hereby represents and warrants to Secured Party and Bank, as of the Effective Date and as of each date on which this Agreement remains in effect, as follows:

\[ADDED: \<!\-- indent:1 \--\> (a) **Ownership.** Depositor is the sole and exclusive legal and beneficial owner of the Accounts and all funds, property, and proceeds therein, free and clear of all Liens other than the security interest and Lien of Secured Party as contemplated by the Loan Documents and this Agreement.
\(b\) **No Prior Control Agreements.** Depositor has not granted control of, or any Lien on, the Accounts (or any funds therein) to any person or entity other than Secured Party.

**[Selected Provisions]{.underline}**

Excerpted from that certain Credit Agreement dated as of April 14, 2025 (as amended, restated, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time, this \"Agreement\"), among **GRAYCLIFF INDUSTRIES, INC.**, a Delaware corporation (the \"Borrower\"), the Lenders from time to time party hereto, and **PINNACLE CAPITAL PARTNERS, LLC**, a Delaware limited liability company, as Administrative Agent and Collateral Agent (in such capacities, the \"Administrative Agent\" and the \"Collateral Agent,\" respectively).
**Senior Secured Revolving Credit Facility --- \$175,000,000**
**Maturity Date: April 14, 2030**

The following provisions are excerpted for reference purposes only and do not constitute the complete Credit Agreement. Capitalized terms used but not defined in these excerpts have the meanings assigned to them elsewhere in the Credit Agreement. In the event of any inconsistency between these excerpts and the Credit Agreement as executed, the Credit Agreement as executed shall control. Section references, unless otherwise indicated, are to sections of the Credit Agreement.
**[ARTICLE I --- DEFINITIONS AND ACCOUNTING TERMS]{.underline}**
**Section 1.01 --- Defined Terms**
As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below:

**\"Account Control Agreement\"** means, with respect to any Deposit Account maintained by the Borrower or any Subsidiary, an agreement, in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent, among the Borrower (or such Subsidiary), the Collateral Agent, and the relevant Depository Bank, effective to grant the Collateral Agent \"control\" (as defined in Section 9-104 of the UCC) over such Deposit Account, and otherwise satisfying the requirements of Section 6.14. Each Account Control Agreement shall be a \"Collateral Document\" and a \"Loan Document\" for all purposes under this Agreement and the other Loan Documents.
**\"Closing Date\"** means April 14, 2025.

**\"Collateral\"** means all assets, property, and interests in property of the Borrower and each other Loan Party in which a Lien is granted or purported to be granted pursuant to any Collateral Document, including, without limitation, all Deposit Accounts, all funds on deposit therein, and all proceeds thereof, together with all other collateral described in the Security Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, the term \"Collateral\" includes all funds held in any Controlled Account and all proceeds and products thereof, whether now owned or hereafter acquired, and whether tangible or intangible.

**\"Collateral Documents\"** means, collectively, the Security Agreement, each Account Control Agreement, each Intellectual Property Security Agreement, and all other agreements, instruments, and documents executed in connection with this Agreement that are intended to create, evidence, or perfect a Lien in favor of the Collateral Agent for the benefit of the Secured Parties on any Collateral. Each Collateral Document is a \"Loan Document\" for purposes of this Agreement.

**\"Control\"** means (a) with respect to any Deposit Account, \"control\" as defined in Section 9-104 of the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in the relevant jurisdiction, and (b) with respect to any securities account, securities entitlement, commodity account, or commodity contract, \"control\" as defined in Section 8-106 or Section 9-106, as applicable, of the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in the relevant jurisdiction. The terms \"Controlled\" and \"Controlling\" shall have correlative meanings.

**\"Controlled Account\"** means each Deposit Account of the Borrower or any Subsidiary that is subject to an Account Control Agreement in favor of the Collateral Agent, including, without limitation, the accounts identified on Schedule 6.14 hereto (as such schedule may be updated from time to time in accordance with Section 6.14(d)). For the avoidance of doubt, an \"Excluded Account\" (as defined in Section 6.14(a)) shall not constitute a \"Controlled Account\" unless and until an Account Control Agreement has been executed and delivered with respect thereto.
**\"Deposit Account\"** has the meaning assigned to such term in Section 9-102(a)(29) of the UCC.

**\"Depository Bank\"** means, with respect to any Deposit Account, the bank or financial institution at which such Deposit Account is maintained. A Depository Bank may, but need not, be a Lender hereunder or an Affiliate of a Lender.
**\"Event of Default\"** has the meaning assigned to such term in Section 7.01.

**\"Notice of Exclusive Control\"** or **\"NOEC\"** means a written notice delivered by the Collateral Agent (acting at the direction of the Required Lenders or as otherwise provided herein) to a Depository Bank pursuant to the terms of an Account Control Agreement, directing such Depository Bank to cease complying with instructions originated by the Borrower or any other Loan Party with respect to the relevant Controlled Account and to comply solely with instructions originated by the Collateral Agent with respect to such account. A Notice of Exclusive Control shall be in writing and may be delivered by any means of delivery permitted under the relevant Account Control Agreement, including by electronic mail to the contact person specified therein. The Collateral Agent shall promptly deliver a copy of any Notice of Exclusive Control to the Borrower and the Administrative Agent; *provided* that the failure to deliver such copy shall not affect the validity or effectiveness of any such Notice of Exclusive Control as against the relevant Depository Bank.

**\"Secured Obligations\"** means all obligations of every nature of the Borrower and each other Loan Party from time to time owed to the Administrative Agent, the Collateral Agent, any Lender, or any other Secured Party under or in connection with this Agreement, any Note, any Letter of Credit, any Swap Agreement with a Lender or an Affiliate of a Lender, and each other Loan Document, including all principal, interest (including interest accruing after the commencement of any Insolvency Proceeding, whether or not such interest is an allowed claim in such Insolvency Proceeding), fees, reimbursements, indemnifications, and all other amounts payable thereunder or in connection therewith, in each case whether direct or indirect, absolute or contingent, due or to become due, now existing or hereafter incurred, and including obligations of performance as well as obligations of payment, and including interest and other amounts that accrue after the commencement of any Insolvency Proceeding (or that would accrue but for the commencement of such Insolvency Proceeding), in each case whether or not a claim for post-filing or post-petition interest or other amounts is allowed in such Insolvency Proceeding.

**\"UCC\"** means the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect from time to time in the State of New York; *provided* that if, by reason of mandatory provisions of law, the perfection, the effect of perfection or non-perfection, or the priority of a security interest in any Collateral is governed by the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in a jurisdiction other than New York, the term \"UCC\" shall mean the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect from time to time in such other jurisdiction for purposes of the provisions hereof relating to such perfection, effect of perfection or non-perfection, or priority. Unless otherwise specified herein, all references to sections of the UCC shall refer to the Uniform Commercial Code as in effect in the State of New York on the date of this Agreement; *provided* that if, by reason of amendments to the Uniform Commercial Code enacted after the date hereof, the numbering or substance of any referenced section is changed, such reference shall be deemed to be to the successor provision most closely corresponding to the referenced provision.
**[ARTICLE VI --- AFFIRMATIVE COVENANTS]{.underline}**

*So long as any Lender shall have any Commitment hereunder, any Loan or other Secured Obligation shall remain unpaid or unsatisfied, or any Letter of Credit shall remain outstanding, the Borrower shall, and shall cause each Subsidiary to:*
**Section 6.14 --- Deposit Accounts**

**(a) Maintenance of Deposit Accounts.** Maintain all of its primary operating, collections, and payroll Deposit Accounts with Depository Banks that have entered into Account Control Agreements with the Collateral Agent, and shall not open any new Deposit Account (other than a Deposit Account in which the aggregate balance does not at any time exceed \$250,000 (each, an \"Excluded Account\")) unless, prior to or concurrently with the opening thereof, the Borrower delivers to the Collateral Agent a fully-executed Account Control Agreement with respect thereto. The Borrower shall not permit the aggregate balance in all Excluded Accounts to exceed \$1,000,000 at any time. For purposes of this Section 6.14(a), a Deposit Account shall be deemed a \"primary\" operating, collections, or payroll account if, during any consecutive thirty (30) day period, the average daily balance in such account exceeds \$250,000 or the aggregate amount of deposits into such account exceeds \$500,000. The Borrower shall not redesignate or reclassify any Controlled Account as an Excluded Account, or take any other action for the purpose of circumventing the requirements of this Section 6.14.

**(b) Delivery of Account Control Agreements.** No later than forty-six (46) calendar days following the Closing Date (i.e., on or before May 30, 2025), deliver to the Administrative Agent fully-executed Account Control Agreements with respect to each Deposit Account identified on Schedule 6.14 (other than any Excluded Account), each such Account Control Agreement to be in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent and effective to grant the Collateral Agent Control over each such Deposit Account in accordance with Section 9-104 of the UCC. Without limiting the foregoing, each such Account Control Agreement shall:

> \(i\) provide that the Depository Bank will comply with instructions originated by the Collateral Agent directing disposition of the funds in each Controlled Account without further consent by the Borrower, and that such obligation shall arise immediately upon the Depository Bank\'s receipt of such instructions and shall not be conditioned upon, or subject to delay by reason of, any notice to or consent by the Borrower or any other Person (other than the Collateral Agent);

> \(ii\) contain a subordination of any Lien, security interest, right of set-off, or banker\'s lien in favor of the Depository Bank (other than customary fees and return items) to the Lien of the Collateral Agent, such subordination to be effective at all times, including following delivery of a Notice of Exclusive Control, and to apply to all amounts on deposit in the relevant Controlled Account from time to time;

> \(iii\) require the Depository Bank to comply with any Notice of Exclusive Control delivered by the Collateral Agent, including by ceasing to comply with instructions of the Borrower with respect to the relevant Controlled Account within the time period specified therein (which time period shall not exceed two (2) Business Days following receipt of the Notice of Exclusive Control by the Depository Bank), and to maintain such exclusive compliance with the Collateral Agent\'s instructions until such time as the Collateral Agent delivers a written revocation of the Notice of Exclusive Control to the Depository Bank; and

> \(iv\) contain representations by the Depository Bank that it has not entered into any other agreement granting Control over such Deposit Account to any Person other than the Collateral Agent, and a covenant by the Depository Bank that it will not enter into any such agreement without the prior written consent of the Collateral Agent.

The Borrower shall use commercially reasonable efforts to cause each Depository Bank to execute and deliver the applicable Account Control Agreement within the time period specified in this Section 6.14(b). The Borrower shall bear all costs and expenses associated with the negotiation, execution, and delivery of each Account Control Agreement, including any fees charged by any Depository Bank in connection therewith.

**(c) Perfection.** Cause the Collateral Agent\'s security interest in each Controlled Account to be perfected by Control at all times following the delivery of the Account Control Agreement with respect thereto. The Borrower acknowledges that a security interest perfected by Control has priority over a security interest perfected only by filing under UCC Section 9-327. The Borrower shall not take any action, or permit any action to be taken, that would terminate, impair, or otherwise adversely affect the Collateral Agent\'s Control over any Controlled Account, including, without limitation, (i) closing any Controlled Account without the prior written consent of the Administrative Agent, (ii) amending, modifying, or terminating any Account Control Agreement without the prior written consent of the Administrative Agent, or (iii) granting or permitting any other Person to obtain Control over any Controlled Account.

**(d) Updates to Schedule 6.14.** Promptly (and in any event within fifteen (15) Business Days) following the opening of any new Deposit Account (other than an Excluded Account) or the closing of any existing Controlled Account, deliver to the Administrative Agent (i) written notice thereof, setting forth the name and address of the Depository Bank, the account number, the account type, the purpose of such account, and the anticipated average balance therein, and (ii) in the case of a newly-opened Deposit Account, a fully-executed Account Control Agreement with respect thereto in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent. Upon delivery of such notice, Schedule 6.14 shall be deemed updated to reflect the opening of such new Deposit Account or the closing of such existing Controlled Account, as applicable. The Borrower shall also deliver to the Administrative Agent updated versions of Schedule 6.14 on a quarterly basis (concurrently with the delivery of financial statements pursuant to Section 5.01), reflecting all Deposit Accounts then maintained by the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, the Depository Bank at which each such account is maintained, the account number and type, and the approximate balance therein as of the last Business Day of the applicable fiscal quarter.

accounts. A $50,000 cap is de minimis and provides no meaningful protection =

aining a cap, at a minimum it must be tied to the aggregate balances in the c=
ontrolled accounts =E2=80=94 not an arbitrary low-dollar figure that bears no=
relationship to the amounts at stake.

=E2=80=94 Firm Rejection**
The Bank's markup extends the scope of indemnification to cover losses arisin=
g from the Bank's own gross negligence. This must be rejected. Pinnacle will =
not agree to indemnify Ironbridge for its own gross negligence. Standard mark=
et practice is to carve out gross negligence and willful misconduct from the =
depositary bank's indemnification protections. This is a firm position =E2=80=
=94 not negotiable.

um**
Our form provided for a 2-business-day compliance period following delivery o=
f a Notice of Exclusive Control. The Bank marked this up to 5 business days. =

h an express right for the Secured Party to transition the accounts to a new =

egal Fee Reimbursement**
The annual ACA maintenance fee of $3,500 per account ($10,500 total for the t=

iated down or capped at a lower figure. This seems high for what should be a =

ree to a reduced cap.

Turn 2:
- **UCC Article 8 terminology (=C2=A7 2(a)):** You flagged the Bank's substit=
ution of "instruction" for "entitlement order." I defer to you on the UCC imp=
lications, but we need to make sure we maintain proper entitlement order lang=
uage to preserve our perfection. Please correct this.
- **Springing exclusive control structure:** I support maintaining the spring=
ing exclusive control framework. The Bank's carve-out allowing Graycliff to c=
ontinue operating the accounts until delivery of a NOEC is acceptable in conc=
ept, provided the NOEC compliance timeline is tightened to 3 business days pe=
r my guidance in item 3 above.
- **Conflicting instructions waterfall (=C2=A7 3):** The Bank's markup insert=
s its set-off rights as taking priority over Secured Party instructions. This=
is interrelated with the subordination issue in item 4 =E2=80=94 please addr=
ess holistically in the counter-markup.
- **Deleted representations:** The Bank deleted (i) the representation regard=
ing no prior control agreements or liens (=C2=A7 12) and (ii) the successor-b=
ank notification obligation (=C2=A7 13). Please push back on restoring both. =
The no-prior-lien representation is important for our comfort that Pinnacle's=
security interest is first priority, and the successor-bank notice obligatio=
n is necessary for continuity of perfection in the event Ironbridge transfers=
the accounts.
- **Consequential damages waiver (=C2=A7 7(b)):** The Bank inserted a mutual =
waiver of consequential, punitive, and indirect damages. I defer to your judg=
ment on whether to accept this or push back =E2=80=94 please flag your recomm=
endation when you send me the draft Turn 2 markup.
**Timeline**
I want to emphasize how important the timeline is here. Under Credit Agreemen=
t =C2=A7 6.14(b), we have a hard May 30, 2025 perfection deadline for deliver=
y of the fully executed ACA. This is a post-closing deliverable that the synd=
icate lenders are watching closely. Any delay or failure to deliver by May 30=
could trigger concerns =E2=80=94 and potentially compliance issues =E2=80=94=
among the lending group. From Credit Agreement execution on April 14, we had=
46 calendar days, and we've already burned roughly half of that.

k period on the set-off (=C2=A7 8), which provides the Bank a reasonable wind=
ow to exercise set-off for obligations that may have arisen before delivery o=
f a NOEC.
**4. NOEC Compliance Period (=C2=A7 5).** The Bank's markup extends the NOEC =
compliance period from two (2) business days (as in the Pinnacle form) to fiv=
e (5) business days. Ironbridge's internal operations and compliance review p=
rocedures require adequate time to verify the authenticity of a NOEC, coordin=
ate among internal departments (including treasury operations, legal, and com=
pliance), and implement the instructions across three separate accounts.
**5. Indemnification (=C2=A7 6).** The Bank's markup broadens the indemnifica=
tion to include coverage for Bank gross negligence. Ironbridge's standard for=
m requires indemnification protection commensurate with the Bank's role as an=
accommodation party to the control arrangement.
**6. Liability Cap (=C2=A7 7(a)=E2=80=93(b)).** The Bank has inserted an aggr=
egate liability cap of $50,000 in =C2=A7 7(a). Ironbridge is acting in an acc=
ommodation capacity and does not benefit economically from the security arran=
gement other than through modest maintenance fees; accordingly, the Bank's po=
licy is to cap its exposure at a level proportionate to its fee income rather=
than the account balances. Additionally, =C2=A7 7(b) introduces a mutual wai=
ver of consequential, punitive, and indirect damages.
**7. Termination (=C2=A7 9).** The Bank's markup provides Ironbridge with a u=
nilateral right to terminate the ACA on thirty (30) days' prior written notic=
e. The Bank requires flexibility to exit the arrangement in the event of chan=
ges to its risk appetite, regulatory requirements, or the customer relationsh=
ip, and 30 days is consistent with Ironbridge's standard institutional terms.
**8. Governing Law (=C2=A7 10).** The Bank has changed the governing law from=
New York to North Carolina. Ironbridge is headquartered in Charlotte, North =
Carolina, the accounts are maintained by Ironbridge's Institutional Deposit S=
ervices group located here, and the Bank's standard practice is to have all d=
eposit-related agreements governed by North Carolina law.
**9. Fees (=C2=A7 11).** The Bank has inserted an annual maintenance fee of $=
3,500 per account ($10,500 in the aggregate for the three accounts) and a one=
-time legal-fee reimbursement of $15,000 for the Bank's outside counsel costs=
in connection with the negotiation and documentation of the ACA. These are I=
ronbridge's standard fees for institutional deposit-account control arrangeme=
nts.
**10. Representations =E2=80=93 Prior Control Agreements / Liens (=C2=A7 12).=
** The Bank has deleted the representation regarding the absence of prior con=
trol agreements or liens on the accounts. Ironbridge is not in a position to =
make representations regarding the Depositor's other arrangements or encumbra=
nces, as these are outside the Bank's knowledge and control.
**11. Successor Bank Notification (=C2=A7 13).** The Bank has deleted the obl=
igation requiring Ironbridge to notify the Secured Party before transferring =
the accounts to a successor institution. In the event of a merger, acquisitio=
n, or other change of control, notification obligations of this nature may co=
nflict with regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations applicable t=
o the Bank.
The foregoing is a summary only, and I would encourage you and your team to r=
eview the full redline for all changes. The Bank's revisions are consistent w=
ith Ironbridge's standard institutional deposit-services documentation and ha=
ve been reviewed and approved by Jonathan Kehoe and the Bank's internal legal=
team.
We are happy to discuss any of the foregoing and would welcome the opportunit=
y to schedule a call at your or Thomas's convenience to address any questions=
. We are mindful of the perfection-related timing constraints under the Credi=
t Agreement and are prepared to work constructively to finalize the ACA in a =
timely manner. We hope the parties can move toward a mutually agreeable form =
